rows.title: No provider confirms the exact all-in-one job
rows.detail: No retrieved source confirms this exact stuck trip-lever extraction plus storage-unit ceiling restoration, nor current availability or acceptance.
rows.action: Use the shortlist as inquiry leads only; obtain one written combined scope and schedule before claiming a provider can do the job.

rows.title: Supplied quote amounts are owner reports, not verified prices
rows.detail: The $614/$550/$135 amounts and scopes came from the owner; no quote documents or contractor confirmations were supplied. Earlier canonical pages suppressed the amounts, preventing the requested comparison.
rows.action: Show supplied amounts in an owner-reported column, leave independently verified amounts blank, and requote one identical scope.

rows.title: The three estimates are not like-for-like
rows.detail: Replacement, lever/plug/spout-diverter, and handle adjustment are different scopes. “Spout/diverter” may not mean the waste-and-overflow assembly.
rows.action: Annotate parts and access/restoration assumptions before comparing prices.

rows.title: No supplied quote explicitly prices ceiling opening/restoration
rows.detail: Silence about drywall is not proof of exclusion, but no combined plumbing-plus-restoration price is on file.
rows.action: Obtain a written fallback price with opening, patch/panel, texture, paint, cleanup and permit assumptions.

rows.title: Quote validity and current pricing are unconfirmed
rows.detail: The supplied date is 2026-08-30; no validity period or current requote was supplied.
rows.action: Ask each provider to confirm validity or issue a current written quote.

rows.title: B + C-36 does not automatically prove drywall self-performance
rows.detail: Earlier pages said B + C-36 “covers both trades directly.” Official C-9/BPC §7057 sources require an appropriate contract/classification structure; C-36 is plumbing, C-9 is drywall.
rows.action: Name the restoration party and license in the contract; ask whether work is self-performed or subcontracted.

rows.title: SF Building Group is B-only on the checked record
rows.detail: #1106131 shows B, not C-36. Plumbing must be appropriately licensed/subcontracted; the site also emphasizes larger planned projects.
rows.action: Do not label it a plumber; identify the C-36 and restoration parties and confirm small-job acceptance.

rows.title: HARP/24-7 is B-2, not B or C-36
rows.detail: #1105133 is B-2 only. BPC §7057.5 requires three unrelated trades and restricts structural work and plumbing-system replacement/substantial alteration.
rows.action: Do not group it with multi-trade B licensees or treat it as an automatic plumbing-plus-drywall fit.

rows.title: Kenneth Asire Plumbing is bond-suspended
rows.detail: #1027286 is suspended for contractors-bond suspension; recorded bond cancellation is 2026-08-16. CSLB notes a replacement bond may not yet be processed.
rows.action: Exclude from the active shortlist; recheck the official record before any reconsideration.

rows.title: Advanced Plumbing carries a future-suspension warning
rows.detail: #1009195 is current and active but CSLB warns it may be suspended at a future date for an unresolved final liability.
rows.action: Review the official warning and recheck before engagement; do not infer the underlying merits.

rows.title: D G Construction has a complaint-disclosure link
rows.detail: #297604 is active B + C-36; the disclosure lists citation 2 2022 002099 dated 03/23/2023, for disclosure only per B&P 7124.6.
rows.action: Read the official citation/disclosure and CSLB limits; active status is not a clean-history guarantee.

rows.title: Save-On-Interior and Bay Area Plumbing share address/phone, not proven ownership
rows.detail: #749536 (B + C-36) and #757796 (C-36) share a registered street address and phone. CSLB does not establish common control or which entity would contract.
rows.action: Confirm the legal contracting entity and license used on any quote; do not merge the identities.

rows.title: Portola Plumbing Services identity is unresolved
rows.detail: The name appears in prior research/Yelp excerpts, but no exact CSLB legal entity/license match was confirmed.
rows.action: Leave license, phone, status and expiry blank; use the official lookup before adding it to a shortlist.

rows.title: Yelp business pages were blocked; ratings/counts are blank
rows.detail: Yelp returned HTTP 403 to automated retrieval again on 2026-11-08, as it did in earlier sessions. Ratings, review counts and review text are therefore blank on every page; only URL strings and search-index excerpts are recorded.
rows.action: Re-check any review figure manually in a browser at the time of contact; never treat an indexed excerpt as a verified review.

rows.title: Rapid Flow wall-opening account is adjacent, not exact-job proof
rows.detail: A Yelp-indexed account describes tub-plug retrieval through a wall opening/pipe cut. It does not establish this trip-lever job, ceiling restoration or a current protocol.
rows.action: Ask for a direct reference and written scope; keep the observation unverified.

rows.title: Ace occupied-home review is old and not a current protocol
rows.detail: An indexed older account mentions masking/booties; the business page was blocked and no current written containment plan was retrieved.
rows.action: Request the provider’s current occupied-unit plan and insurance evidence.

rows.title: Heise’s case studies are self-published and contain a 404 template block
rows.detail: The Ingleside/Mission/Marina project pages render project content but embed a “Page Not Found (404)” template block. The Ingleside page describes ceiling access; none proves drywall restoration.
rows.action: Treat as adjacent company evidence, not independent verification; ask for references and the restoration party.

rows.title: Heise’s license has no B or C-9
rows.detail: #1089561 shows A/C-10/C-20/C-36. It is a strong plumbing case-study lead, not a verified drywall/restoration contractor.
rows.action: Name a properly licensed restoration partner or contract structure.

rows.title: Bernal Hill is a restoration partner, not a plumber
rows.detail: #995163 shows B + C-9 and advertises patch/paint/texture/build-back, but no C-36.
rows.action: Use only for the restoration leg under a lawful combined contract; verify the plumber separately.

rows.title: We Do, Ayoob & Peery and SF Building Group emphasize larger/commercial work
rows.detail: Official sites position these firms around design-build, commercial wet-side systems or larger planned projects. Small occupied-unit repair acceptance is unconfirmed.
rows.action: Confirm minimum job size and availability before prioritizing; do not infer refusal.

rows.title: Job-specific permit determination is still open
rows.detail: SF.gov requires a permit before cutting/replacing pipes; §104.2 exemptions are conditional. No DBI written determination for this exact scope was supplied.
rows.action: Get the permit answer in writing before work; do not assume exemption or infer a permit-free path.

rows.title: SF Plumbing Code §104.2 is now retrieved; earlier “unverified” flag is corrected
rows.detail: The operative exemption text was directly retrieved from American Legal Publishing chunk 14. Earlier canonical pages still listed it as not retrievable.
rows.action: Publish the exact conditional exemptions and link the code; keep job applicability open.

rows.title: Access-panel dimensions remain unverified
rows.detail: IAPMO chapter 4 redirected to a members-only login; no operative 12-inch access-panel text was retrieved. A SF code-amendments URL returned 404.
rows.action: Leave dimensions blank and ask DBI/contractor for the applicable written requirement.

rows.title: Official fee category is not a confirmed job price
rows.detail: Table 1A-C lists Category 1P at $290 and separate inspection rates, but the job category and whether quotes include fees are unconfirmed.
rows.action: Budget fees separately only after DBI/quote confirmation; do not add them blindly or present them as total cost.

rows.title: Building age, paint and suspect materials are unknown
rows.detail: Lead RRP and asbestos controls are conditional. No age/material assessment or photographs were supplied.
rows.action: Screen before disturbing finishes; use qualified professionals if suspect material is present.

rows.title: Storage-unit authority and affected tenancies are unconfirmed
rows.detail: The space below may be a separate unit/common area; ownership, consent and notice recipients were not supplied.
rows.action: Confirm authority and give each affected tenant the required notice before scheduling.

rows.title: No reference photographs or exact assembly model were supplied
rows.detail: Analysis is description-based; manufacturer instructions are model-specific and cannot identify the stuck unit.
rows.action: Collect photos/model/size before finalizing parts and access strategy.

rows.title: Workers-comp “exempt” is not general-liability proof
rows.detail: Several CSLB records certify no employees. That does not establish general-liability coverage or coverage for subcontractors.
rows.action: Request current certificates for every onsite party and match the legal entity.

rows.title: Fast Response registered-address wording differs from the website
rows.detail: CSLB prints “236 W POTRAL AVE #459”; the company site uses a different address presentation. The official record is not silently corrected.
rows.action: Use the CSLB wording for the license row and confirm the current business address directly.

rows.title: Save-On-Interior has 2015–2016 CSLB miscellaneous entries
rows.detail: The record lists cash-deposit letters. No current disciplinary inference is made from those entries.
rows.action: Read the official record and ask the contractor if relevant; do not infer misconduct.

rows.title: A third-party directory misattributes license #297604
rows.detail: Earlier research found contractorlicenseca.com associating #297604 with Cahill; the official CSLB record for #297604 is D G Construction, while Cahill is #300647.
rows.action: Use CSLB as the license authority; do not publish the directory attribution.

rows.title: The repository also hosts unrelated DOE GEMS research
rows.detail: Legacy GEMS source/evidence/docs/downloads remain preserved and are not part of the repair analysis.
rows.action: Keep the repair dashboard canonical and link the legacy archive separately; do not delete unrelated work.

rows.title: Parallel sessions produced duplicate and conflicting bathtub routes
rows.detail: Earlier root/bathtub/bathtub-overflow/bathroom-overflow/trip-lever/docs routes disagreed on counts, classifications, amounts and permit/code claims. Main now uses redirect stubs and archives.
rows.action: Preserve stubs/archives/history; publish one canonical root dashboard and log superseded claims.

rows.title: GitHub Pages status has lagged/errored across rapid merges
rows.detail: The Pages API reported errored/building states during multiple same-hour merges; an old successful build is not proof of the current commit.
rows.action: Verify the specific merge commit, served content and build result; use a checked static-artifact workflow if legacy deployment remains unreliable.

rows.title: No provider has been contacted or booked
rows.detail: This research did not submit forms, call providers, confirm availability, negotiate price or create an appointment.
rows.action: Use the ready-to-send scope sheet for inquiries; record responses before updating fit/availability fields.

rows.title: PR #33 was closed unmerged and its branch deleted
rows.detail: The 22-license audit/analysis commit remains accessible by SHA and was reviewed; it is not merged over the newer main baseline.
rows.action: Preserve the commit reference and incorporate independently rechecked facts; do not silently discard the parallel work.

rows.title: The hire ranking is editorial decision support, not a verified performance rating
rows.detail: The ranked page is a subjective weighted inquiry order, not a quality rating. Review pages were retrieved, but customer accounts are not independently adjudicated; provider acceptance, exact-job performance and price remain unconfirmed.
rows.action: Use the ranking to decide who to call first, then replace the score with documented answers, a written combined scope and a fixed price once providers respond.

rows.title: Clever Plumbing & Rooter was licensed on 2026-09-04
rows.detail: The CSLB record shows an issue date of 2026-09-04 with a workers-compensation exemption (certified no employees). The licence is current and active, but there is no tenure or published evidence for delicate occupied-unit work.
rows.action: Keep it below the shortlist and treat any quote as unproven until references and insurance are produced.

rows.title: Three earlier-session pull requests remain open and unmerged
rows.detail: PRs #35, #38 and #39 were opened on 2026-11-07 by other sessions. One of them carries a failing check. They conflict with the merged canonical dashboard, so merging them would revert verified work.
rows.action: Owner decision: close them, or have the owning session rebase onto the current main. This session did not touch another session's pull request.

rows.title: Repository hygiene: case-colliding run cards and 26 stale session branches
rows.detail: run_card.json and RUN_CARD.json both exist at the repository root. On a case-insensitive filesystem (macOS, Windows) a clone keeps only one, so the two records can silently diverge. In addition, 26 remote arena/* session branches remain after their pull requests merged or closed.
rows.action: Rename or archive one of the two run-card files, and delete merged session branches. Neither affects the published dashboard.

rows.title: In & Out #878184: six historical CSLB citations
rows.detail: CSLB shows an active license and six citations dated 2017–2018: three completed and three for disclosure only. Individual entries include a building-law permit violation, trade standards, contracting classification and down-payment issues. They are historical, not proof of a current violation.
rows.action: Read the original disclosure and individual citation links; seek an explanation and extra diligence before hiring. Compare with other candidates and obtain a written, itemized contract.

rows.title: The three owner-quote names are not confirmed license matches
rows.detail: The owner supplied names and amounts, but no quote document or company confirmation ties the named estimates to CSLB #977638, #757796 or #1024971. Fast Response is especially generic.
rows.action: Ask each business to confirm the issuing entity and obtain the original document; leave verified license/amount fields blank for the quotes.

rows.title: One In & Out bathtub review is a probable, not proven, profile match
rows.detail: The June 2026 bathtub-pipe review is on a same-name South San Francisco HomeAdvisor profile that does not display the license number. The separate electrical/drywall review is on a profile displaying #878184.
rows.action: Confirm the first profile belongs to the licensee; do not combine profile ratings or claim either review establishes this exact job.

rows.title: Lead-safe and service-repair contract rules are conditional
rows.detail: RRP has limited exceptions and §7159.10 separately governs qualifying service/repair contracts; building conditions and contract type are unknown.
rows.action: Screen the actual painted surfaces and work method, and obtain the appropriate written contract; do not infer an exemption from the owner-reported price.

rows.title: A source link is not proof of every statement in a row
rows.detail: Company pages, official classification/CSLB records, owner statements and independent reviews support different claims. A nearby official context link does not verify an owner-reported estimate or an unadjudicated customer account.
rows.action: Use the source-type labels and limitations; check each factual claim against its specific source before relying on it.
